replacement.title: Preserve Product Routing at www.lotclip.com
replacement.definition: Keep www.lotclip.com available as the product-domain alias, redirecting to the existing lotclip.com product route rather than returning a Firebase Site Not Found page.

patches.decision_note: The www alias has a failure and repair trajectory independent of the apex product route and marketing-site subdomain.

replacement.title: Contact Page Availability
replacement.definition: Provide the independently accessible contact page used for the Founding Dealer and early-access experience.

patches.decision_note: Contact-page availability is independently implementable from its copy, form behavior, and CTA routing.

replacement.title: Early-Access CTA Routing
replacement.definition: Route the landing-page early-access call-to-action to the intended contact or Founding Dealer destination.

patches.decision_note: The extraction finding identifies CTA connection as behavior separate from contact-page construction.

replacement.title: Early-Access Contact Form
replacement.definition: Provide a form through which prospective Founding Dealers can submit their information for follow-up.

patches.decision_note: The supplied page copy explicitly requires visitors to complete a form, whose availability and submission behavior are independent of page copy.

replacement.title: Dealer-Login Button Placement
replacement.definition: Display the dealer-login button only in the top-right location rather than repeating it throughout the landing page.

patches.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes an independently testable placement rule for the dealer-login button.

replacement.title: Cost-Effective Webflow Plan
replacement.definition: Use the lowest-cost suitable Webflow site plan after completing the initial build on the free account.

patches.decision_note: Webflow plan selection is an independently changing hosting constraint rather than an attribute of constructing the landing-page artifact.

replacement.title: No Phase-One Animations
replacement.definition: Do not include animations in the time-bounded phase-one landing-page launch.

patches.decision_note: The client explicitly states a presentation constraint that can evolve independently of the overall visual style.
Adding an already-promised color palette to a source document is asset-transfer activity, not a change to the visual-design Requirement.
The unavailable referenced option prevents recovery of a concrete value, and the generic approval adds no distinct evidence beyond later explicit design approval.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer provides a Loom link in the site-editing tutorial delivery exchange.

patches.decision_note: The link supports delivery of a context-resolved Loom artifact, but the source does not itself assert multiple recordings or ask whether the instructions are clear.

The extraction finding indicates a completion statement and get.lotclip.com URL, but the raw text is absent here; verify whether a target-specific implementation claim or runtime verification was missed.
